user.title: Connect FutureBit Apollo III Standard
user.description: Enter the miner's address and its Apollo dashboard password. The Apollo has no username.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the Apollo III Standard controller, for example 192.168.1.50.
data_description.port: Port of the Apollo API. Leave at 5000 unless you changed it.
data_description.password: The password you use to log in to the Apollo web dashboard.

dhcp_confirm.title: Apollo III Standard found
dhcp_confirm.description: An Apollo III Standard was found at {host}. Enter its dashboard password to add it.

data_description.port: Port of the Apollo API. Leave at 5000 unless you changed it.
data_description.password: The password you use to log in to the Apollo web dashboard.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Apollo III Standard
reconfigure.description: Change the miner's address, port or password. Leave the password blank to keep the current one.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the Apollo III Standard controller.
data_description.port: Port of the Apollo API. Leave at 5000 unless you changed it.
data_description.password: Only needed if the dashboard password changed.

reauth_confirm.title: Apollo III Standard password changed
reauth_confirm.description: The Apollo III Standard at {host} rejected the saved password. Enter the current dashboard password.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Apollo API. Check the host and port, and that the miner is powered on.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: This Apollo III Standard is already set up.
abort.wrong_device: That address belongs to a different Apollo III Standard than this entry.
